title: Corrupt Biome
body:
The Corrupt biome was an area located in The Desert. It was added during the 2024 Halloween event with purplish red and purple ground with purple crystals, and WAS mistaken to be a permanent addition. However, only the materials were stated to be permanent.

This biome was possibly a reference to the The Corruption from Terraria.

In this area you could find: Corrupt Deadwood, Corrupted Cactus, Corrupt Acacia Corrupted Limestone and corrupted tumbleweed.

The supposed source of corruption was a large infused core with floating boulders surrounding it.

During the Halloween updates, the corruption seemed to grow larger per update.

It seems the corruption is related to mysterious mushrooms and that it causes the corruption like the mysterious mushrooms itself gained a purpose to "invade and conquer" causing the large infused core or the supposed corruption core to be created.

Evidence suggests that the corrupted meteor caused the caves and surrounding biomes to begin corrupting, yet somehow the corruption receded to only be in the caves. The only remaining remnant of the once growing spread of corruption are the Mysterious Mushrooms (and crystals) which cause any material hit with one of it's spores to turn into its subsequent corrupted variant.

The corrupted meteor used to reside in a tunnel it created, leading to a small underground area. However, as of now, the meteor has been removed and only the tunnel remains.
